## ② Ledger

## ③ Hot-file serial queue

`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`: objectui#12156 (the `max_size` hint at `:1154`) is next, now that R3 has landed. No other entry.

## ④ Notes

- **Carried lessons:** base merges go to the PR's own dev or the relay's `pr_update_branch` op; a bare `update-branch` is ⛔. Byte-adding PRs queue one at a time against the eager-closure ceiling. Dispatches name the whole `scripts/__tests__/` suite. A PR body becomes the squash message, so a sentence a later push made false is corrected before ready; os-dev does not patch PR bodies, so the seat writes the correction. A red `Test` aggregator on a superseded head is its shards reading `cancelled`.
- **Lessons from this shift:** (1) Before setting `pm:blocked` on an upstream, re-read that upstream's state in the same act (release `6113419180`, corrected by `6113447708`). (2) A published package README can go false with a type change. Grep the touched package's README for the keys a round declares (PR #12166's README patch).
- **Contract review:** this session was not at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; every review ran in an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **Verification layer:** a merge here reaches users through the published `@object-ui/*` packages; landings are verified on `main` by content and `git patch-id --stable`.
